description: This script manages Android device debugging sessions using LLDB and GDB, including starting gdbserver, attaching to processes, and generating debugger setup scripts.

methods.name: read_toolchain_config
methods.description: Finds out current toolchain version by executing a script.

methods.name: get_lldb_path
methods.description: Locates the LLDB debugger executable within the given toolchain path.

methods.name: get_lldb_server_path
methods.description: Constructs the path to the lldb-server binary based on architecture.

methods.name: get_tracer_pid
methods.description: Retrieves the tracer process ID from a device for a given PID.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for attaching or running processes, port, environment, and forwarding options.

methods.name: verify_device
methods.description: Checks if the connected device matches the target product environment.

methods.name: get_remote_pid
methods.description: Finds the PID of a process by name on the device.

methods.name: make_temp_dir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and tracks it for cleanup.

methods.name: ensure_linker
methods.description: Ensures the device's linker exists on the host, copying or pulling it if necessary.

methods.name: handle_switches
methods.description: Determines the binary or process to attach to based on command-line args.

methods.name: generate_vscode_lldb_script
methods.description: Creates a JSON configuration for VSCode LLDB debugging.

methods.name: generate_lldb_script
methods.description: Generates LLDB commands to attach to a binary.

methods.name: generate_setup_script
methods.description: Creates a setup script for LLDB or VSCode LLDB, including search paths and commands.

methods.name: do_main
methods.description: Main execution flow handling environment setup, process attachment, debugger startup, and cleanup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that calls do_main and handles cleanup of temporary directories.
